# AquaZen

> AquaZen is a hot tub and swim spa store at 7049 Russell Ave, Burnaby, BC V5J 4R8, Canada. Visits are by appointment. It delivers anywhere from Whistler to Hope: Whistler, Squamish, West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Vancouver, Burnaby, New Westminster, Richmond, Delta, Surrey, White Rock, Langley, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Pitt Meadows, Maple Ridge, Mission, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Agassiz, Harrison Hot Springs, Hope. It sells AquaSolus hot tubs and swim spas, set up with the right equipment from day one, with honest advice and care for the life of the tub. Founder: Shaun McAvoy, over twenty years in the hot tub industry. Phone or text 236-304-4424, email shaun@aquazen.ca.

## Why people choose AquaZen
- A hot tub is a place of peace at home. AquaZen helps people choose the tub that gives them that every night, and will recommend a smaller tub when it is the better fit.
- Some stores cut corners and skip the best options, then make it up later on chemicals and service calls. AquaZen sells the right equipment from day one: 56-frame pumps (not 48-frame) on 240V tubs, water turned over in under 10 minutes, a double ozonator with a 45-second mixing chamber then UV, and AQ10 insulation that keeps 100% of the water insulated 100% of the time.
- Simple water care: 1 teaspoon of chlorine granules after each soak. AquaZen recommends chlorine, not bromine.
- Local help: an exclusive electrical partner (Gerry Jansen), a pre-delivery guide with exact path sizes for every model, a delivery team that records each tub's serial number and photos, and a customer account with care guides and service requests.
- AquaSolus tubs are handmade on a hand-welded 304 stainless steel frame with a sealed ABS base.

## Hot tubs
- [Series One (AquaPure)](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-one/): Plug in. Find your Zen. Four hot tubs for 4 to 7 people that run on a standard 120V outlet, or a 40 amp line if you have one. The simplest way to start your Zen Time.
  - [Brook](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-one/brook/): The compact one. Four seats, on a standard outlet. 4 people, 23 jets, 84 x 71 x 31 in, 15 A 120V, or 40 A 240V. Made for couples and small families, and smaller patios. The easiest way to start.
  - [Zephyr](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-one/zephyr/): Two loungers, three seats, room for five. 5 people, 25 jets, 84 x 84 x 35 in, 15 A 120V, or 40 A 240V. Made for two people who both want to stretch out, with room for the kids or friends.
  - [Cypress](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-one/cypress/): A lounger and five seats, on a standard outlet. 6 people, 26 jets, 84 x 84 x 35 in, 15 A 120V, or 40 A 240V. Made for families who want a lounger without giving up seats.
  - [Cove](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-one/cove/): Seven upright seats. The most room in Series One. 7 people, 27 jets, 84 x 84 x 35 in, 15 A 120V, or 40 A 240V. Made for bigger families and anyone who has friends over often.
- [Series Two (NaturaBalance)](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-two/): Full power, every night. Five hot tubs for 3 to 7 people with two pumps on a dedicated 60 amp line, so the heater and the jets run at full power together. Made for nightly Zen Time, all year round.
  - [Sierra](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-two/sierra/): Two loungers and a seat. Zen for two, or three. 3 people, 40 jets, 89 x 71 x 31 in, 60 A 240V dedicated line. Made for couples who want to lie back side by side, every night.
  - [Harmony](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-two/harmony/): Two loungers, three seats and 42 jets. 5 people, 42 jets, 84 x 84 x 37 in, 60 A 240V dedicated line. Made for couples and small families who want two loungers and full power.
  - [Eden](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-two/eden/): Six people, one lounger, 42 jets. 6 people, 42 jets, 84 x 84 x 37 in, 60 A 240V dedicated line. Made for families of four to six who use the tub most nights.
  - [Aspen](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-two/aspen/): Six people, one lounger and 48 jets, the most in Series Two. 6 people, 48 jets, 91 x 79 x 37 in, 60 A 240V dedicated line. Made for anyone who wants the deepest massage in the series, with room for six.
  - [Calma](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-two/calma/): Seven upright seats, for the whole family. 7 people, 38 jets, 84 x 84 x 37 in, 60 A 240V dedicated line. Made for big families and people who entertain, with full power for every seat.
- [Series Three (AquaLux)](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-three/): The peak of Zen. Our most advanced hot tubs. Programmable massage, real-time water monitoring and the full EcoPure water system, in four models for 5 to 7 people.
  - [Cascade](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-three/cascade/): Two full-length loungers, three seats, 45 jets. 5 people, 45 jets, 91 x 91 x 37 in, 60 A 240V dedicated line. Made for couples who both want a lounger, with programmable massage.
  - [Serenity](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-three/serenity/): Six people, a full-length lounger, 49 jets. 6 people, 49 jets, 91 x 91 x 37 in, 60 A 240V dedicated line. Made for families who want the best water care and a lounger for the end of the day.
  - [Zenith](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-three/zenith/): Our largest tub. Seven people, 61 jets. 7 people, 61 jets, 110 x 91 x 37 in, 60 A 240V dedicated line. Made for big families and anyone who wants the most room and the most jets.
  - [Solstice](https://aquazen.ca/hot-tubs/series-three/solstice/): Seven upright seats, made for gathering. 7 people, 41 jets, 91 x 91 x 37 in, 60 A 240V dedicated line. Made for families and friends who soak together, with the best water care.

## Swim spas
- Swim spas (AquaSolus Swim Spa Series): Six AquaSolus swim spas, 14 to 19 ft long, for 2 to 12 people. Swim against river jets or a 9-speed turbine, then sit back under the hydrotherapy jets when you're done.
  - Solara: Twelve places and 53 jets. The social swim spa. 14 ft, 12 people, River jets.
  - Drift: A full swim lane in a 14 ft footprint. 14 ft, 2 people, River jets.
  - Fusion: Two zones: swim on one side, soak on the other. 19 ft, 3 people, River jets.
  - Fusion Professional: Two zones, with a turbine swim current. 19 ft, 3 people, 9-speed turbine.
  - Flow: A 19 ft swim lane with a river current. 19 ft, 2 people, River jets.
  - Flow Professional: The 19 ft lane with a turbine current. 19 ft, 2 people, 9-speed turbine.

## Questions people ask
- **Where can I buy a hot tub in Burnaby?** AquaZen is at 7049 Russell Ave, Burnaby, BC. We sell AquaSolus hot tubs and swim spas, and we'd love for you to come sit in one. Call or text 236-304-4424 to book a quiet visit, so you can take your time and bring the people you'll be soaking with.
- **What makes AquaZen different from other hot tub stores?** Some stores cut corners and skip the best options, then make it up later on chemicals and service calls. We think that's backwards. Every tub we sell has the right equipment from day one: 56-frame pumps, water cleaned in under 10 minutes by a double ozonator and UV, and AQ10 insulation that keeps 100% of the water insulated 100% of the time. The water stays clean and easy, and you spend your time enjoying it, not fixing it.
- **Why do you sell AquaSolus hot tubs?** AquaSolus builds around one idea: health through water. Their tubs are handmade on a hand-welded 304 stainless steel frame with a sealed ABS base, and they do the important things exceptionally well: clean water, a deep massage, and heat that stays where it belongs. That matches what we believe a hot tub should be: a place of peace at home.
- **Which hot tub is right for me?** It depends on who's soaking, how often and where. Series One is plug and play on a standard outlet, the easiest start. Series Two is full power on a 60 amp line for people who soak every night. Series Three is our best, with programmable massage and real-time water monitoring, for people who've owned a hot tub before and know they love it. Find your Zen at aquazen.ca/find-your-zen takes a minute, and we'll help you find the one.
- **Do you sell swim spas?** Yes. AquaSolus swim spas from about 14 to 19 feet, for 2 to 12 people, with river jets or a 9-speed turbine to swim against. Swim, train and soak at home.
- **Will you tell me if a smaller hot tub is a better fit?** Yes. If a smaller tub is the better fit, I'll tell you. I'd rather you love it than overspend.
- **Do you deliver hot tubs to my area?** Yes, anywhere from Whistler to Hope. Our own delivery crew covers Whistler, Squamish, West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Vancouver, Burnaby, New Westminster, Richmond, Delta, Surrey, White Rock, Langley, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Pitt Meadows, Maple Ridge, Mission, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Agassiz, Harrison Hot Springs and Hope, and everywhere in between. Wherever you are, you get the same careful setup and the same people looking after you afterwards.
- **What electrical does a hot tub need in BC?** Series One runs on a dedicated 15 amp 120V GFCI-protected outdoor receptacle, or a 40 amp 240V line. Series Two and Three need a dedicated 60 amp 240V line with a GFCI disconnect, installed by a licensed electrician under a permit. In most of BC that permit comes from Technical Safety BC, and some cities, including Burnaby, Vancouver and Surrey, issue their own.
- **Who should wire my hot tub?** Our electrical partner is Gerry Jansen. He knows our tubs better than anybody and wires them properly the first time. Call or text him at 778-229-2560.
- **Should the electrical be done before or after delivery?** Either works. We recommend after: once the tub is in place, your electrician comes once, sees exactly where the equipment is, and wires it start to finish in one visit.
- **What base does a hot tub need?** A solid, flat, level base that stays that way: a level concrete pad, or compacted crushed gravel in a timber frame topped with level patio slabs. A deck works only if a structural engineer confirms it can carry the full weight. Grass, soil, sand or slabs laid on soil aren't suitable.
- **How do you get the hot tub into my backyard?** We move it on its side on a spa dolly, so the path needs to be as wide as the tub is deep and as tall as its longest side, plus a little room for the dolly. Our pre-delivery guide lists the exact path size for every model. If walls or slopes block the way, a crane can lift it over.
- **How long does delivery take?** When you sign, you choose: as soon as possible, or a two-week window that suits you. As that time comes up we call to book the exact day.
- **How much maintenance does an AquaSolus hot tub need?** Very little. The double ozonator does most of the work, so the only sanitizer you add is 1 teaspoon of chlorine granules after each soak. Rinse the filter once a week, check calcium once a month, and change the water every 3 to 4 months. A few minutes a week.
- **Should I use chlorine or bromine?** Chlorine. We don't recommend bromine in our tubs. With the double ozonator doing so much, a teaspoon of chlorine after each soak is all your AquaSolus needs.
- **How do I look after hot tub water with Lower Mainland soft water?** Our water is naturally soft and acidic, so on each fresh fill raise total alkalinity first, then set pH, then add calcium hardness increaser, then chlorine. Balanced water is gentle on your skin and protects the heater and jets.
- **Is a hot tub expensive to run in our winters?** An AquaSolus is built to run lean. AQ10 insulation keeps the pumps, heater and every line inside the insulated envelope, so heat stays in the water and the pumps' own warmth goes back to work. Keep the cover on and locked whenever you're not soaking.
- **What happens if I need service?** Every AquaZen customer gets an account with their agreement, delivery photos, serial number, care guides and a service request button that comes straight to us. We recommend a service visit at least once a year.
